scope: Stage243 and later GPT V1700 full-series creative OS development

north_star_alignment.goal: Autonomous long-form literary generation operating system with planning, creation, critique, revision, and measured learning loop.

goal_layers.name: Controlled Detailed Prose and Manuscript Generation

priority_order.name: Authority and Safety Split
priority_order.description: Keep local hub and remote GitHub authority separated; no raw corpus, vectors, tokens, adapter weights, or provider output in hub.

priority_order.name: FullSeriesArcSpec / SeasonPlan schema
priority_order.description: Define the top-level 16/24 episode arc contract before lower-level scene schemas.

priority_order.name: EpisodeArcChain schema
priority_order.description: Define episode-to-episode state transition, escalation, midpoint, crisis, climax, and resolution structure.

priority_order.name: SequenceBlueprint schema
priority_order.description: Define sequence-level dramatic purpose and scene cluster requirements.

priority_order.name: SceneBlueprint schema
priority_order.description: Define scene purpose, function, causality, plant/payoff, character/relationship delta, and renderer constraints.

priority_order.name: LLMRendererPromptPacket schema
priority_order.description: Define how blueprints become controlled prompts for later LLM prose rendering.

priority_order.name: FullSeasonCandidatePackage schema
priority_order.description: Package full series arc, episode arcs, sequence/scene blueprints, self-checks, scorecard preflight, and revision plan.

priority_order.name: Fixture-only Full Series Candidate Package
priority_order.description: Create metadata-only candidate package without provider generation or raw text.

priority_order.name: Hard-Rule Self-Check across full season
priority_order.description: Apply hard-rule gate to full series, episode chain, sequence, and scene blueprint levels.

priority_order.name: Scorecard Preflight
priority_order.description: Apply scorecard only after hard-rule pass.

priority_order.name: Gate A Review Packet
priority_order.description: Review candidate structures as Gate A evidence, not as promotion.

priority_order.name: Heldout / Negative-Control Evaluation
priority_order.description: Test candidate robustness against heldout fixtures and negative controls.

priority_order.name: Page18 Controlled Prose Generation Preparation
priority_order.description: Prepare for controlled generation only after structural evidence is sufficient.

priority_order.name: Controlled Detailed Scene Prose Generation
priority_order.description: Generate detailed scenes only under Page18 controlled boundary.

priority_order.name: Episode Manuscript Assembly
priority_order.description: Assemble generated scenes into coherent episode manuscripts.

priority_order.name: Full Season Manuscript Assembly
priority_order.description: Assemble episodes into full 16/24 episode season manuscript.

priority_order.name: Evaluation / Revision / Regeneration Loop
priority_order.description: Evaluate generated output, create revision plans, regenerate, and compare improvement.

priority_order.name: LearningSignalPacket and measured improvement registry
priority_order.description: Register safe measured learning signals without raw prose memorization or unapproved canonical mutation.
